messages:
aj: quick heads-up — some clients are still sending the old v1 header. Do we want the platform to auto-fallback to v1 semantics when an app exceeds v2 quota, or should we fail loud and force an SDK/console migration?

sam: i'm leaning toward fail-with-good-error. silent fallbacks cause subtle correctness bugs. we should give a clear migration path. :thinking_face:

maria: telemetry shows ~2.3% of requests bear v1 tokens, mostly older SDKs. we could do a short soft-fallback that tags responses and samples diffs for quality. gives us data without surprising customers.

kevin: agree with sampling. console toggle per-tenant would also help support teams opt-in for fallback during migrations. keep default = strict.

consoleux: UI idea: "Compat mode" card on tenant page with states: Strict | Soft-fallback (sample) | Soft-fallback (all) | Disabled. show a diff rate and a one-click rollback for canary.

ops: if we enable soft-fallback even for sampling we need these metrics: compat_shim.routed, compat_shim.sampled_diff_fail, compat_shim.latency_delta, and per-tenant 4xx spikes. alerts: >1% diff_fail sustained for 10m.

kevin: also need quota mapping rules spelled out. v1 had per-minute buckets and generous burst; v2 is per-token steady. naive fallback can blow past a tenant's intended limits.

maria: provisional mapping suggestion (for soft mode): map v1-minute-window => v2 per-token budget using historical median tokens/min. fallback should respect the tenant's committed capacity.

sam: add events: `compat_shim.routed`, `compat_shim.sampled`, `compat_shim.diff_fail`. prefixed by tenant id and route. these feed the dashboard.

kevin: example config we could add to runtime:```yaml
compat_routing:
  mode: soft-fallback
  sample_rate: 0.05
  quota_map: 
    v1_to_v2: median_tokens_per_minute
  tag_header: X-Compat-Shim
```

aj: plan proposal: 1) enable sampled soft-fallback (5%) for 2 weeks, route to v2-compat-shim and emit diffs 2) console: per-tenant Compat card + opt-in toggle 3) telemetry & alerts from ops 4) docs + SDK deprecation banner 5) hard-enforce after 2 weeks if diff_fail < 0.5%

deploy-bot: canary deploy started: v2-compat-shim -> routing group "compat-canary" (5% of v1-identified traffic) at 2024-12-01T12:05:00Z

ops: flagged — i'll wire alerts and a dashboard tile for compat_shim.* metrics. recommend a heatmap of tenant diff_fail by percent and a time-series of latency_delta.

consoleux: i'll mock screenshots of the card and add an explanatory tooltip about "semantic diffs" and the risk of silent fallback. will post by EOD.

sam: minor note: Dedicated customers need an explicit admin API to opt-out; console toggle isn't enough for private control planes.

kevin: true. include a tenant-level API and a policy bundle for Private deployments.

maria: also, add a sampling endpoint so we can fetch failed diffs and attach to a migration ticket for the customer.

aj: assigned tasks: sam -> telemetry events + SDK banners; ops -> alerts + dashboard; consoleux -> UI mock + copy; kevin -> quota mapping spec + private API; maria -> diff collection hook; deploy-bot -> keep canary running and widen if signals OK. timeline: soft-fallback live in 2 weeks, review after 14d, then decide hard-enforce. objections?

kevin: no objections. :thumbsup:

maria: good plan. :+1:

sam: sounds reasonable. i'll start the events PR.

aj: cool — i'll post a short note in announcements and draft the SDK migration checklist.

consoleux: will post mock here when ready. :eyes:
